top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Size of Mesh Openings (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(G))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 out of 3 play yards had holes in the mesh larger than 1/4" size.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Discipline (26 TAC §746.501(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It has been found that parents did not receive updated operational policies in regards to discipline.

top_violation_types.title: Safety restraint devices for child used when vehicle is on and during all time vehicle in motion (26 TAC §746.5607(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained, students are not wearing the required seatbelts while the bus is in motion.
